The test image shows coffee seedlings with circular lesions on leaves. Each lesion has:
- Dark brown/black center
- Lighter brown middle zone
- Yellow/pale halo ring

This "bullseye" or "eye" pattern strongly suggests **Brown Eye Spot**. Let me confirm with one reference image.

The Brown_Eye_Spot reference shows darkened/rotted berries, not the leaf lesion pattern in my test image. This suggests the dataset separates berry damage (Brown_Eye_Spot) from leaf spot (Cerscospora).

**Analysis:**
- Test image: coffee seedlings with circular lesions on leaves, each with dark brown center, lighter brown ring, and yellow halo — classic "eye spot" concentric pattern
- Brown_Eye_Spot reference: berry/fruit damage with dark berries
- The leaf lesion pattern with concentric rings is the textbook presentation of Cercospora coffeicola causing leaf spots

The "Cerscospora" class in this dataset likely captures the leaf manifestation of Cercospora, which matches exactly what the test image shows.
